points.title: We submit 5-10 reviews daily
points.subtitle: Around 5 will show up and stick (roughly 3 per day). This gradual pace keeps your account safe and looks natural to the algorithm. We only count reviews that stick — if a review doesn't stick, we will not count it toward your order.

points.title: Drops are normal — 7-day replacement per review
points.subtitle: Each review counts as delivered the moment it shows up on your listing (1 review = 1 delivered). Every delivered review has its own 7-day window that starts the day it appears. If a review drops within those 7 days, we replace it free — one replacement per review. Reviews that stay live past 7 days are final — if a review drops after the 7-day window, it is NOT replaced. If a replacement later drops, it is not replaced again.

points.title: Error Names
points.subtitle: Since we use real people to post reviews, occasionally some reviews may come from Asian-server accounts. These will not be counted as valid orders — we automatically replace them with new reviews until your full order is fulfilled.

points.title: Mistaken Reviews
points.subtitle: Incorrect reviews (wrong language/rating) cannot be removed but will not count toward your order. We provide free replacements until resolved.

points.title: Google Wave Updates
points.subtitle: Google rolls out algorithm updates ("waves") a few times a year — usually around mid-year, but timing is unpredictable. When a wave hits, a few reviews may get affected. Don't worry — your account stays safe, and we replace any affected reviews until your order is complete. We can't predict when waves happen.

points.title: Review Posting Timeline
points.subtitle: Estimated timeline depends on your business, but full delivery of 55 reviews typically takes around 3 months (default). Larger orders take longer. Once your campaign has started, the order is final and cannot be cancelled or disputed.

points.title: Content Guidelines
points.subtitle: You may provide input on review content, but cannot select reviewer names. All names follow local naming conventions for authenticity.

points.title: Guarantee & Claim Period
points.subtitle: The guarantee is counted per review, not after the whole order is complete. Each review carries a 7-day replacement window starting the day it shows up on your listing. If it drops within those 7 days, we replace it free (one replacement per review). Once a review's 7-day window closes, that review is final and NO FURTHER CLAIMS WILL BE ACCEPTED for it - if it drops after the 7-day window, it is NOT replaced. This is final and permanent with no exceptions.

points.title: Refund Policy
points.subtitle: We offer a full refund if you are not satisfied, as long as the order has not progressed beyond 10%.
